description: This BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX* POWERCONNECT cordless 4-tool combo kit includes a drill/driver, a circular saw, a MOUSE detail sander, and a work light. The drill/driver is designed with an 11-position clutch to help prevent you from stripping and overdriving screws, while its keyless chuck makes swapping out the bit really easy. Plus, it’s equipped with a built-in LED work light to illuminate your worksurface. Use the circular saw for powerful and fast cutting on a variety of materials and to make angled cuts, too. Its tool-free adjustment lets you adjust the cutting depth without extra tools. When it’s time for surface preparation and finishing tasks, turn to the MOUSE detail sander for speedy material removal. This sander even comes with a detail finger attachment for accessing difficult-to-reach spaces. And the versatile pivoting LED work light is an all-around great go-to for lighting up dark areas. This 4-tool combo kit comes with two 20V MAX* POWERCONNECT batteries that are rechargeable and can be used with all tools in the set, as well as with other tools in the POWERCONNECT system. *Maximum initial battery voltage (measured without a workload) is 20 volts. Nominal voltage is 18 volts.
